sections.h2: Who handles deed recording in Alcona County, and what is the number?
sections.html:
Deeds and mortgages for Alcona County property are filed with the Register of Deeds in Harrisville, reachable at 989-724-9450 (fax 989-724-9459). The office page describes the job as the official recording point for every legal paper touching real estate, run under a uniform state system.

That page lists the papers it takes: warranty and quitclaim deeds, mortgages with their assignments and discharges, land contracts, liens and releases, easements, rights of way, oil and gas leases, plats, surveys, land corners and court orders. Passport applications are accepted there too.

Counter staff cannot draft your deed or weigh in on legal questions, so lean on a lawyer or the closing agent for that. The county also keeps a closure list that includes Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving and the Friday after, so phone ahead before you carry a signed original to the courthouse.

sections.h2: What fees apply when you file a deed at the Alcona County counter?
sections.html:
Filing runs $30.00 per paper regardless of length, the figure fixed in MCL 600.2567 and printed on the Alcona page. A few add-ons exist:

  • $3.00 extra for every further instrument when one document assigns or discharges several.
  • $1.00 a page for photocopies of the record, with $5.00 on top to certify.
  • $5.00 for the treasurer's tax certificate, which spans up to five property descriptions, then 20 cents per added description.

Mailing it in has quirks. Enclose a stamped, self-addressed return envelope. If your check overshoots the fee by $10.00 or less, the county keeps the difference, so total the charges before you send anything.

sections.h2: Which Alcona County papers need the treasurer's certificate first?
sections.html:
Warranty deeds, land contracts and their assignments, condominium master deeds, subdivision plats and any deed that conveys with a warranty must arrive with a certificate from the Treasurer's Office, 989-724-9420. The register's page states this directly.

Make this stop first on your errand list, since the certificate travels with the deed to the register. Holding a different deed form, such as a quitclaim? Ask the register if the same rule reaches it.

The same counter can tell you whether any tax is still unpaid on the parcel. Knowing that number before you pick a closing date avoids a last-minute surprise.

sections.h2: How is the Michigan transfer tax figured on an Alcona County sale?
sections.html:
Two levies stack on the seller. The county charges $0.55 for each $500 of value (MCL 207.504) and the state charges $3.75 for each $500 (MCL 207.525), rounding any leftover amount up to a full $500.

Try the math on $162,800, the 2020 to 2024 median value for an Alcona County owner-occupied home in Census Bureau data. It contains 326 blocks of $500.

Transfer tax on a $162,800 Alcona County sale, computed from the rates in MCL 207.504 and 207.525
LevelPer $500Total
County$0.55$179.30
State$3.75$1,222.50
Both levels$4.30$1,401.80

The county treasurer collects within 15 days of delivery (MCL 207.523). Put the full price on the face of the deed, or file a value affidavit with it.

sections.h2: Can an Alcona County family transfer avoid the transfer tax?
sections.html:
Often yes. MCL 207.526 carves out gifts inside a family, which is the usual case for heirs and aging owners.

  • Parent to child, including a stepchild or adopted child.
  • Grandparent to grandchild, including step and adopted grandchildren.
  • Spouses creating or ending a tenancy by the entireties.
  • Any instrument carrying consideration under $100.
  • A corrective deed that confirms title the grantee already holds.

If you paid and then learn an exemption applied, the state Treasury Department takes refund requests.

sections.h2: Why might Alcona County turn a deed away?
sections.html:
Michigan's recording act, MCL 565.201, gives a register grounds to refuse papers that break its layout rules. Four checks cover most trouble:

  • Leave a clear top margin of 2 1/2 inches on page one.
  • Open with a single line that names the event, such as "Warranty Deed."
  • Use 10-point or larger type in black ink on white 20-pound stock.
  • Print the drafter's name and business address on the paper.

Keep one event per sheet. A first line claiming two recordable events, such as a deed plus a release, bars recording.

sections.h2: Which other Alcona County offices matter when a house sells?
sections.html:
Several county desks can touch a sale, and the directory on the county home page gives each one's line.

  • Treasurer, 989-724-9420: tax certificates and balances.
  • Equalization, 989-724-9430: assessed and taxable values.
  • Building Department, 989-724-9440: permits.
  • County Clerk, 989-724-9410, and Probate Court, 989-724-9490: records and estate matters when the owner has died.

Alcona County sits in Michigan's 23rd Circuit, shared with Arenac, Iosco and Oscoda counties. An heir selling an inherited house should ask Probate Court what paperwork the deed needs before anything goes to the register.

sections.h2: What should an owner know about Alcona County itself?
sections.html:
Alphabetically first among Michigan's 83 counties, Alcona was created in 1840 and organized in 1869. Of its 1,791 square miles, 62 percent is water, mostly Lake Huron and inland lakes such as Hubbard Lake, one of the state's twenty largest. The Au Sable River crosses the southwest, with the Alcona Dam in Curtis Township, and part of the Huron National Forest lies within the borders.

Harrisville is the sole city and the county seat, and Lincoln is the village. Townships on the county list are Alcona, Caledonia, Curtis, Gustin, Greenbush, Harrisville, Haynes, Millen and Mitchell.

About 10,556 people lived here in mid-2025, roughly 15 per square mile. Older adults are 37.4 percent of the population, 89.6 percent of housing is occupied by its owner, the median household earns $54,993 and the average worker travels 27.9 minutes, against 17.5 in neighboring Alpena County.

Zoning, permits and assessments sit with townships and the county, not with the register. The Building Department is at 989-724-9440 and Equalization at 989-724-9430. Call them if a permit or valuation question could hold up your sale.

sections.h2: How has Alcona County grown, and what do homes cost to carry?
sections.html:
The county was first named Negwegon and took the Alcona name in 1843. Its 2010 census count was 10,942 and its 2020 count was 10,167, and the Census Bureau's mid-2025 estimate of 10,556 is a 3.9 percent rise over the April 2020 base.

Housing figures for 2020 to 2024 show 5,305 households averaging 1.94 people, which fits a county where more than a third of residents are 65 or older. Owners with a mortgage report median monthly costs of $1,096, owners without one $441, and median gross rent is $867.

Work is thin on the ground. The county had 182 employer establishments and 1,126 paid jobs in 2023, and retail sales of $91.7 million in 2022, or $8,820 per person. Only 42.7 percent of people 16 or older are in the labor force.

faqs.q: What is the filing price for a deed in Alcona County?
faqs.a: It is $30.00 a document. A paper that assigns or discharges several instruments adds $3.00 for each extra, and copies of records cost $1.00 a page.

faqs.q: Who must pay the transfer tax in an Alcona County sale?
faqs.a: The seller must, since MCL 207.523 puts the liability on the grantor. The county treasurer expects payment inside 15 days from delivery of the deed.

faqs.q: Is a treasurer's certificate required before an Alcona County warranty deed is recorded?
faqs.a: Yes. The Treasurer's Office issues it at 989-724-9420 for $5.00 per document with up to five descriptions.

faqs.q: Can a deed go to the Alcona County register by mail?
faqs.a: Yes, if you add a stamped return envelope addressed to yourself. Any mailed overpayment of $10.00 or under becomes county revenue.

faqs.q: Is there an online search for Alcona County land records?
faqs.a: Yes, two fee-based tools: Laredo, which works by subscription, and Tapestry. Ask the register at 989-724-9450 how to sign up for Laredo.
